ownership.summary: Hayward Holdings, Inc. is a publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under HAYW and owned collectively by its shareholders. Hayward Industries, Inc. is its primary operating subsidiary. Large institutional beneficial holders disclosed in the 2026 proxy are shareholders, not a separate corporate parent for the Hayward brand.
ownership.parentCompany: Hayward Holdings, Inc. is the public parent

leadership.name: Kevin Holleran
leadership.context: Hayward's 2025 Form 10-K and 2026 proxy identify Kevin Holleran as president and chief executive officer.

productPortfolio.name: Automatic pool cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Robotic, suction, pressure and in-floor cleaner systems span residential and professional pool-care applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm cleaner architecture, pool compatibility, cable or hose system, parts, authorized service and model warranty.

productPortfolio.name: Pumps and filtration
productPortfolio.positioning: Variable-speed pumps and filters form core circulation and water-quality platforms for new pools and replacement demand.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: System sizing, hydraulic compatibility, energy regulation, installer qualification and local approval must be checked.

productPortfolio.name: Heating and sanitization
productPortfolio.positioning: Gas heaters, heat pumps, salt systems and sanitizers broaden Hayward into complete pool-environment management.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Fuel, electrical, climate, water chemistry, certification and service requirements are market and model specific.

productPortfolio.name: Automation, lighting and controls
productPortfolio.positioning: Connected controls, LED lighting and water-feature systems integrate multiple equipment categories.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Buyers should verify ecosystem compatibility, software region, installer support, cybersecurity updates and replacement parts.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Hayward reported seven manufacturing facilities at the end of 2025: four in the United States, two in Spain and one in China.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: A factory list does not identify the plant or origin of an exact cleaner, pump, controller or replacement part.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Hayward says more than 3.8 million products were manufactured in its U.S. facilities in 2025 and represented 87% of sales value.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not turn the group-level figure into a blanket Made in USA claim for every product.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Product manuals and legal exhibits name specific Hayward Pool Products entities for defined equipment or countries.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the manual, label, declaration and warranty to the exact SKU, market and production period.

marketsChannels.evidence: Hayward estimates that about 80% of U.S. residential pool-equipment sales move through distributors, 15% directly to retailers and 5% to builders.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the actual seller, distributor authorization and warranty route for the transaction.

marketsChannels.evidence: The company estimates European sales at about 77% through distributors and 23% through direct sales.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify the regional company, importer, invoice seller, service center and applicable commercial terms.

marketsChannels.evidence: Hayward serves other international markets through regional operations and established distributors.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm current territory rights, product availability, local approvals, parts stock and technician coverage.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Hayward's advantage is system breadth across circulation, filtration, heating, sanitization, cleaning, lighting and automation, reinforced by professional distribution and a substantial manufacturing footprint. Its diligence challenge is translating a public-company and factory-level picture into exact model responsibility across operating entities, distributors, dealers and warranty documents.
